name: Dead Air on the Ghost Frequency
description: A pirate-radio rig has gone quiet, and its last broadcast may still be recoverable. The rig runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199, and recover the broadcast record.

tasks.name: Recover the transmission
tasks.description: A pirate-radio rig has gone quiet, and its last broadcast may still be recoverable. Find it on the lab network: scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199, and recover the broadcast record.
hints: A port number is only a place to knock. Pay attention to the responses you get back.
One service speaks a familiar key-value protocol despite its unexpected port.
Use the service's read commands to inspect available keys, then retrieve the broadcast record's value.
